reference_sql:
SELECT ch.channel_name, SUM(a.spend) AS spend,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(a.spend) / SUM(SUM(a.spend)) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct
FROM ad_spend_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND a.spend_date <= DATE '2025-10-31'
GROUP BY ch.channel_name
alternatives:
WITH period_spend AS (  -- one row per spend row from July to October 2025
  SELECT ch.channel_name, a.spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND a.spend_date <= DATE '2025-10-31'
)
SELECT channel_name, SUM(spend) AS spend,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(spend) / (SELECT SUM(spend) FROM period_spend), 2) AS share_pct
FROM period_spend
GROUP BY channel_name

WITH channel_spend AS (  -- one row per channel with spend from July to October 2025
  SELECT ch.channel_name, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND a.spend_date <= DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name
)
SELECT channel_name, spend,
       ROUND(100.0 * spend / SUM(spend) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct
FROM channel_spend

  FROM ad_spend_daily a

  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
  WHERE a.spend_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND a.spend_date <= DATE '2025-10-31'
